name: Bad Medicine

narrative.details:
To have a chance against Kurzen, we need his healing support neutralized.  He has gathered a large number of Medicine Men who heal his forces with Jungle Remedies and poison our fighters with Venom Fern Extracts.

We need those remedies and extracts for our own.  Search the Kurzen Compound - his Medicine Men and Jungle fighers will have the remedies, and the extracts are probably stowed in some of the camp's supply boxes.
narrative.objectives: Bring 7 Jungle Remedies and 1 Venom Fern Extract to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp.
narrative.offerRewardText: Well done, adventurer. These remedies will keep more of us alive and in fighting shape. And the extracts will help us create our own remedies.
narrative.requestItemsText: I'm waiting on those remedies and that extract, adventurer.
